name: Weavewalk
description:
You phase out and remain phased out while the spell lasts. Roll Lore. The result is the duration of the spell, in minutes.

Describe how you phase out.
successes:
✨: Double the spell duration.

🌞: The spell lasts for up to one day.

💀: Roll a d8 at the end of each minute while the spell lasts. On a 1, you immediately phase in, the spell ends and you check a condition.
